b.x: The room

Urban survival is not the bush on the asphalt. It is going on when one city service stops and the others still exist. Blackout, flood, strike, heat, illness, a closed street. Most of it asks you to stay. The smaller part asks you to leave. Whoever trains only the escape trains the wrong day.
The order
The doctrine has an order. It is not a taste.
01 Air. Smoke, gas, water that rises. Without air, the rest does not arrive.
02 Shelter. The building you can still live in. Stairs, two exits, a door that closes.
03 Water. The tap lies first. Three to four liters a person, a day. Flood water is not for drinking.
04 Food. The pantry the house already eats. Hunger waits longer than thirst and longer than the sewage.
05 News. A battery radio and one pact. The crowd is lost too.
06 Discretion. A stock you show becomes an invitation. The gray man does not become the poster of the block.
Stay or leave
Stay when the building is standing, the water is not inside, and the street is the danger.
Leave when the water comes in, the structure groans, there is fire or smoke, or the written plan says point B.
The decision is on paper beforehand. In the dark, the head invents heroism.
The building
A stopped elevator is not a route. The stairs are.
A generator and a brazier do not come into the room. In an urban blackout, after the fear, what kills quietly is the monoxide.
Trash and a dirty hand arrive before hunger. After a flood, in Brazil, dengue and leptospirosis weigh more than the jungle fantasy.
Do not open the door to help you did not ask for. Through the gap: name and reason. If it does not close, do not open it.
Two neighbors know the pact. The whole block does not know what you stored.
What this doctrine refuses

It does not teach a bunker in the window. It does not teach camouflage downtown. It does not teach park plants as a 72-hour plan. It does not teach confrontation, disarming, or evasion of authority. It teaches the order, the paper, and the phone: the local emergency numbers. The step on the street — being followed, a crowd, the night — is in Urban movement. This page is the order. That one is the step.
Educational content. Not a substitute for professional training, medical advice, or local authorities.
